caption:
Swim, bike, run, repeat. Toto trains almost every day, and lately one hip and his lower back keep feeling tight.

All three sports involve a lot of repetition, so trunk and hip control matter. Pilates trains that control all round and can complement your training, not replace it.

Hybi's 1-minute move: single-leg bridge, keeping the pelvis level, 10 each side × 2 sets, 2–3 times a week. Stop if pain gets worse or your leg tingles.

The same spot hurting again and again, or pain that changes your technique, is worth an assessment. Clinical Pilates at Hybrid Physio can help you build a plan. Book online via the link in bio
